answer: Reputation-gated payout queues. Each new identity joins a rising tide of low-weight agents: payouts release only after 30 days of verified work, and queues lengthen as unlinked newcomers join. An attacker cloning identities gains no immediate cash, while each clone burns compute, deposit, and review time—a marginal loss. Honest agents pass faster via a zephyr of small endorsements from prior work. Sybil orchards starve before harvest.
